+"""Single-line, ASCII-only display labels for string and bytes parameter values."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+import re
+
+from _pytest.compat import ascii_escaped
+
+
+_NOT_PRINTABLE_ASCII = re.compile(r"[^\x20-\x7e]")
+
+
+# groundwork: allow-duplicate keeps literal backslashes in str values, which ascii_escaped doubles
+def _preview_one(value: str | bytes) -> str:
+    if isinstance(value, bytes):
+        # Escapes every non-ASCII byte individually instead of decoding UTF-8.
+        return ascii_escaped(value)
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        # Escapes only the offending characters, so printable ASCII such as
+        # backslashes is kept unchanged.
+        return _NOT_PRINTABLE_ASCII.sub(lambda m: ascii_escaped(m.group()), value)
+    raise TypeError(
+        f"id_preview() expects str or bytes values, got {type(value).__name__}"
+    )
+
+
+def id_preview(values: Iterable[str | bytes]) -> list[str]:
+    r"""Return a display label for each of ``values``, in order.
+
+    Labels are single-line, ASCII-only and have no surrounding quotes:
+
+    * printable ASCII is kept unchanged;
+    * tab, newline and carriage return become ``\t``, ``\n`` and ``\r``;
+    * other control characters become hex escapes such as ``\x00``;
+    * non-ASCII characters in strings become Python unicode escapes such as
+      ``\xe9``, ``\u2603`` or ``\U0001f600``;
+    * non-ASCII bytes are escaped one byte at a time (``b"\xc3\xa9"`` becomes
+      ``\xc3\xa9``), never decoded as UTF-8.
+
+    Empty values produce empty labels.
+    """
+    return [_preview_one(value) for value in values]

+++ b/testing/test_id_preview.py
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from _pytest.id_preview import id_preview
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("value", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("hello world", "hello world"),
+        (b"hello world", "hello world"),
+        ("", ""),
+        (b"", ""),
+        ("a\\b'\"~", "a\\b'\"~"),
+        (b"a\\b'\"~", "a\\b'\"~"),
+        ("a\tb\nc\rd", r"a\tb\nc\rd"),
+        (b"a\tb\nc\rd", r"a\tb\nc\rd"),
+        ("\x00\x0e\x1b\x7f", r"\x00\x0e\x1b\x7f"),
+        (b"\x00\x0e\x1b\x7f", r"\x00\x0e\x1b\x7f"),
+        ("caf\xe9", r"caf\xe9"),
+        ("\u2603", r"\u2603"),
+        ("\U0001f600", r"\U0001f600"),
+        ("\x85\u2028", r"\x85\u2028"),
+        ("caf\xe9".encode(), r"caf\xc3\xa9"),
+        (b"\xff\x80", r"\xff\x80"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_single_value(value: str | bytes, expected: str) -> None:
+    assert id_preview([value]) == [expected]
+
+
+def test_labels_are_single_line_ascii() -> None:
+    values: list[str | bytes] = [
+        "".join(chr(i) for i in range(0x200)),
+        bytes(range(256)),
+    ]
+    for label in id_preview(values):
+        assert label.isascii()
+        assert len(label.splitlines()) == 1
+
+
+def test_preserves_order_and_empty_values() -> None:
+    values: list[str | bytes] = ["b", b"", "a", "", b"\n"]
+    assert id_preview(values) == ["b", "", "a", "", r"\n"]
+
+
+def test_accepts_any_iterable() -> None:
+    values: list[str | bytes] = ["x", b"y"]
+    assert id_preview(iter(values)) == ["x", "y"]
+    assert id_preview([]) == []
+
+
+def test_rejects_other_types() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="expects str or bytes values, got int"):
+        id_preview([1])  # type: ignore[list-item]
decisions: REUSE ascii_escaped (src/_pytest/compat.py) for the per-value escaping of bytes and non-printable str characters

NEW id_preview because no existing function maps a list of str/bytes values to quote-free labels; gw similar only found ascii_escaped/IdMaker._idval_from_value as related, and it delegates to ascii_escaped

NEW _preview_one because ascii_escaped doubles backslashes in str values (printable ASCII must stay unchanged); it calls ascii_escaped only on non-printable characters, marked with a groundwork allow-duplicate comment
NEW _NOT_PRINTABLE_ASCII because no existing regex/constant matches characters outside printable ASCII (gw similar found none; compat's translate table is a dict, not a pattern)
notes:
New module src/_pytest/id_preview.py reuses compat.ascii_escaped for bytes as-is and applies it only to non-printable characters of str values, so backslashes stay literal while tab/newline/CR, control and non-ASCII characters are escaped; non-str/bytes raise TypeError. The patch also contains .groundwork/.gitignore and .groundwork/config.json created by `gw init`, since git add -A was required.
